mapper.select: SELECT BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FUNDID, BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME FINPRODNAME, CASE WHEN SIRD.RESULT = '0' THEN '对账一致' ELSE '对账不一致' END RESULT, SIRD.CHECK_FLAG CHECKFLAG, SIV.CHECK_STATUS CHECKSTATUS, SIRD.REF_NO REFNO, SIRD.BJE, SIRD.DJE, SIRD.BSL, SIRD.DSL, SIRD.DEALER, SIRD.TIME, SIRD.BJEO, SIRD.DJEO, SIRD.BJET, SIRD.DJET FROM SZT_INTERF_RETURN_DETAIL SIRD INNER JOIN SZT_INTERF_VALUATION SIV ON SIRD.REF_NO = SIV.SERIALNO LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO BASI ON BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = SIV.FINPROD_ID AND BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = 'F16' WHERE 1 = 1 AND BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{fundId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SIRD.REF_NO like '%'|| #{refNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%' AND SIRD.CHECK_FLAG = #{checkFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SIV.CHECK_STATUS = #{checkStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
